reason: The current evidence does not directly link the venue of the 2017 World Series of Poker to its owner. A bridge note can connect the WSOP to its host casino, and a verification note can confirm the owner of that casino.

derived_candidates.text: The World Series of Poker is hosted at a casino owned by Caesars Entertainment Corporation.
The 2017 World Series of Poker was held at the Rio All-Suite Hotel and Casino.
